I filled the hole with `_≅_.from A≅B , _≅_.fromIsSurjective A≅B`, and check_file now reports success on the final file (exit code 0, no holes, only two deprecation warnings from the library itself).

The proof works because an isomorphism from 𝑨 to 𝑩 includes a homomorphism back from 𝑩 to 𝑨 (`from`), and the library already proves that this map is surjective (`fromIsSurjective`). Pairing them gives exactly what `𝑨 IsHomImageOf 𝑩` asks for.

I also added one import line, `open import Data.Product using ( _,_ )`, because the pair constructor `,` wasn't in scope.
